\[

=\sum_{n\ge 1}\sum_{k\ge 1}10^{-nk}.

Every exponent \(m=nk\) appears once for each divisor pair of \(m\).

Now multiply by \(10^{100}\):

10^{100}S=\sum_{m=1}^{100} d(m)10^{100-m}
+\sum_{m=101}^{\infty} d(m)10^{100-m}.
